items.originalTitle: Guenther Steiner calls out Williams over F1 infrastructure complaints: "Crocodile tears"
items.summaryEn: Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has labelled Williams's complaints about capital expenditure limits as "crocodile tears", questioning team boss James Vowles for continually moving the timeline for the team's recovery.
detailZh: 冈瑟·施泰纳批威廉姆斯就F1基础设施抱怨：“鳄鱼的眼泪”
冈瑟·施泰纳将威廉姆斯对F1资本支出限制的抱怨斥为“鳄鱼的眼泪”。
前哈斯F1车队领队冈瑟·施泰纳将威廉姆斯对资本支出限制的抱怨称为“鳄鱼的眼泪”，并质疑车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯不断推迟这支格罗夫车队的复苏时间表。
自2023年接手威廉姆斯以来，这位英国人多次指出车队过时的基础设施是其试图在F1发车格上攀升的主要限制因素。他积极争取在预算帽之外获得监管豁免，以现代化设施。
但施泰纳在《The Red Flags Podcast》节目中辩称，威廉姆斯不能将其所有权方历史上投资不足归咎于现行财务规则。
“他们中的一些人犯了错误，没有投资车队。说‘哦，我们赢不了比赛是因为我们没有75台五轴机床。我们只有65台’，这是胡说八道，”施泰纳说道，随后澄清他指的是威廉姆斯。
“在我看来，威廉姆斯五年来一直在说同样的话。我想仔细看看他们的预算帽数字。他们是否一直花到上限？如果五年里你都没有花到上限，你能怪谁？怪你自己。
“你不能说，‘哦，我被禁止花钱。’你不能，因为五年前你没有钱。
“你现在不能怪这个体系。我认为有一条出路，因为我总是想找到出路，如果你去找其他车队、找国际汽联说，‘嘿，我们想升级工厂，投资这这那那的钱。’你会获得豁免。
“阿斯顿·马丁也是这样，当劳伦斯·斯特罗尔进来时说，‘我想建一个新工厂，因为约旦车队的老工厂过时了，一切都老旧。’
“他说，‘我想建一个新风洞。’他们说，‘你可以在预算帽之外建一个新风洞，但它不能比F1现有的最好风洞更好。’明白了吗？
“你总是需要谈判。说‘哦，他们不让我做。’他们不让你做，不应该阻止你寻找办法。但首先要做的是表明你实际上没有同样的设施，展示出来，并确保你有钱去做你说的事。
“这是鳄鱼的眼泪，因为去年威廉姆斯的预测是，‘我们专注于26年，我们会好起来。’但詹姆斯去年难道没有意识到他没有设施去做到吗？他等了一年才发现他的设施实际上五年都没有投资。”
威廉姆斯目前以11分位列车队积分榜第九。
detailEn: Guenther Steiner calls out Williams over F1 infrastructure complaints: "Crocodile tears"
Guenther Steiner has dismissed Williams's complaints over Formula 1's capital expenditure limits as "crocodile tears"

Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has labelled Williams's complaints regarding capital expenditure limits "crocodile tears", questioning team boss James Vowles for continually moving the timeline for the Grove outfit's recovery.

Since taking over Williams in 2023, the Briton has repeatedly pointed to the team's outdated infrastructure as a primary limiting factor in its bid to move up the F1 grid. He has actively fought for regulatory allowances outside the cost cap to modernise the facilities.
But, speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner argued that Williams cannot blame the current financial regulations for a historical lack of investment by its ownership.

"Some of them made mistakes not to invest in the team. It's bull**** saying, 'Oh, we cannot win races because we don't have 75 five-axis machines. We have only 65,'" Steiner said before clarifying he was referring to Williams.

"Williams, in my opinion, they've been saying the same thing for five years. And I would like to go through their budget cap numbers. Have they always spent to the maximum? If, in five years, you don't spend to the maximum. Who have you got to blame? Yourself.
"You can't say, 'Oh I was not allowed to spend.' You cannot because you didn't have the money five years ago.

"You cannot blame the system now. I think a way out of this because I always want to get a way out of it, if you go to the other teams, to the FIA and say, 'Hey we would like to upgrade the factory and invest this and this money.' You get the dispensation.
"It was the same with Aston Martin when Lawrence Stroll came in and said, 'I want to build a new factory because this old Jordan factory is out of date and everything is old.'

"He said, 'I want to build a new wind tunnel.' They said, 'You can build a new wind tunnel outside of the budget cap, but it cannot be better than the best wind tunnel existing in Formula 1.' You see?

"You always need to negotiate. It's saying, 'Oh, they don't let me do it.' Because they don't let you do it shouldn't stop you from trying to find a way. But the first thing to have is to show that you're actually not having the same facilities and show that and be sure that you've got the money to do what you're saying.

"It's crocodile tears because last year Williams's prediction was, 'We focus on '26, and we will be good.' But did James not realise last year that he doesn't have the facility to do it? He had to wait a year to find out that his facility actually was not invested in for five years."
Williams currently sits ninth in the constructors' championship with 11 points.
keyPointsZh: 施泰纳认为威廉姆斯不能将历史投资不足归咎于现行财务规则，并质疑其是否一直用足预算上限。
施泰纳以阿斯顿·马丁为例，指出车队可以通过协商获得预算帽外升级设施的许可。
威廉姆斯目前以11分位列车队积分榜第九。
keyPointsEn: Steiner argued Williams cannot blame current financial regulations for historical underinvestment and questioned whether it has always spent to the maximum budget cap.
Steiner cited Aston Martin as an example, noting teams can negotiate dispensation to upgrade facilities outside the cost cap.
Williams currently sits ninth in the constructors' championship with 11 points.

items.originalTitle: Stefano Domenicali reveals bizarre Jimmy Fallon prank at Miami GP Michelin-starred dinner
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali has revealed that American television host Jimmy Fallon interrupted his business dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant during the Miami Grand Prix by sending a takeaway pizza to his table as a prank.
detailZh: 斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利爆料：吉米·法伦在迈阿密大奖赛米其林餐厅的恶作剧
斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利披露了吉米·法伦如何在迈阿密大奖赛期间打断他的商务晚餐
F1首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利详细描述了一次离奇的场外遭遇：美国电视主持人吉米·法伦打断了他在一家米其林星级餐厅的商务晚餐，给他桌上送了一份外卖披萨。
多梅尼卡利在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前做客《吉米·法伦今夜秀》，两人回顾了法伦今年早些时候在迈阿密大奖赛首次体验F1的经历。
两人最初在硬石体育场多梅尼卡利的围场办公室外相遇，当晚又在厨师托马斯·凯勒经营的The Surf Club餐厅碰面。法伦已经用完餐，而多梅尼卡利则在一场商务晚餐中经历了漫长的等待。
注意到上菜延迟后，法伦找到餐厅经理，策划了一个玩笑。
“我跟她聊了聊，我说，‘我想给他送点好玩的东西。我能给他送个吃了一半的肉丸之类的吗？’”法伦在节目中解释道。“然后她说，‘我们没有那个。我不会那么做。我们是米其林星级餐厅。我们不会那么做。’”
“我说，‘那我能送点什么好玩的？’她说，‘你为什么不从隔壁叫个披萨送过去？’于是我就让他们不给你上菜，然后给你送披萨。”
披萨送到时，盒子上附有一张手写便条，写着：“Stefano，以防万一送来的。Jimmy Fallon。”
这位F1掌门人保留了这张便条，以向女儿证明他当天与法伦在一起，并将其带到了《吉米·法伦今夜秀》。
“我留着它是因为我们当时饿坏了。所以你救了我们的晚餐。它就在那儿。我有家人。你是我女儿心中的英雄。所以我想把它带回家，证明你当时和我在一起，”多梅尼卡利解释道。
detailEn: Stefano Domenicali reveals bizarre Jimmy Fallon prank at Miami GP Michelin-starred dinner
Stefano Domenicali has revealed how Jimmy Fallon interrupted his business dinner at the Miami Grand Prix

Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali has detailed a bizarre off-track encounter with American television host Jimmy Fallon, who interrupted his business dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant by sending a takeaway pizza to his table.

Domenicali made an appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, and the pair reflected on Fallon's first experience of F1 at the Miami Grand Prix earlier this year.

Following an initial meeting outside Domenicali's paddock office at the Hard Rock Stadium, they crossed paths later that evening at The Surf Club, a restaurant operated by chef Thomas Keller. While Fallon had already finished eating, Domenicali was enduring a lengthy wait for a business dinner.
Noticing the delay, Fallon approached the restaurant manager to organise a joke.

"I talked to her [and] I said, 'I want to send him something funny. Can I send him, like, a half-eaten meatball or something?'" Fallon explained during the show. "And so she goes, 'We don't have that. I'm not doing that. We're a Michelin Star restaurant. We're not going to do that.'
"I go, 'What can I send that would be funny?' And she goes, 'Why don't you have a pizza delivered from next door?' So I made them not serve you food and then deliver you pizza."
The pizza arrived with a handwritten note attached to the box, reading: "Stefano, delivery just in case. Jimmy Fallon."
The F1 chief kept the note to prove to his daughter that he had been with Fallon that day and brought it to The Tonight Show.

"I kept it because we were starving. So you save our dinner. It's there. I've got a family. You are the hero of my daughter. So I wanted to bring it home to prove that you were with me," Domenicali explained.
keyPointsZh: 多梅尼卡利在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前做客《吉米·法伦今夜秀》，两人回顾了法伦今年早些时候在迈阿密大奖赛首次体验F1的经历。
两人最初在硬石体育场多梅尼卡利的围场办公室外相遇，当晚又在厨师托马斯·凯勒经营的The Surf Club餐厅碰面。
法伦向餐厅经理提议恶作剧，最终安排从隔壁餐厅送披萨到多梅尼卡利的餐桌。
keyPointsEn: Domenicali appeared on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, and the pair reflected on Fallon's first F1 experience at the Miami Grand Prix earlier this year.
They first met outside Domenicali's paddock office at the Hard Rock Stadium, and later crossed paths that evening at The Surf Club, a restaurant operated by chef Thomas Keller.
Fallon proposed a prank to the restaurant manager, which resulted in a pizza being delivered from next door to Domenicali's table.

items.originalTitle: F1 closing in on 1 billion fans as Stefano Domenicali hails female audience growth
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali says the championship is closing in on 1 billion global fans, driven by a younger audience, an increase in female viewership and more access to driver personalities.
detailZh: F1全球粉丝数逼近10亿，斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利盛赞女性观众的增长
一级方程式首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利表示，这项锦标赛的全球粉丝数量正接近10亿
斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利，一级方程式集团首席执行官
一级方程式首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利表示，这项锦标赛的全球粉丝数量正逼近10亿，这得益于更年轻的观众群体、女性观众的增加，以及车手个性魅力的更多展现。
多梅尼卡利在《吉米·法伦今夜秀》节目中发言时，谈到了一级方程式的持续扩张，以及它在美国发展壮大的成功。
“我们的车迷数量几乎达到了10亿。吉米，我们希望将来能回到这里，庆祝这个目标、这个数字。但这个规模非常庞大，”多梅尼卡利解释道。
“一级方程式在世界各地都是一项世界性运动。我们要去全世界24个地方。实际上，今晚在这个难得的机会之后，我将前往阿塞拜疆的巴库，然后去马来西亚，再去新加坡。”
他将这种增长部分归因于通过奈飞的《疾速求生》系列节目以及车手们自己的社交媒体平台，更多地展现了22位车手的个性，这反过来也有助于打造他们的个人形象。
"当然，他们是职业车手，但他们知道自己是一个更大生态体系的一部分，"他接着说。"因为通常你看到他们时，他们戴着赛车手套、头盔，穿着赛车服，所以你认不出他们。现在我们敞开了大门，让他们为人所知。"
多梅尼卡利还指出了在美国迈阿密、奥斯汀和拉斯维加斯举办的三场大奖赛持续取得的成功，并解释说，拉斯维加斯大道赛道的后勤保障挑战已经通过场场爆满的观众人数得到了回报。他还提到了F1电影的成功。这部由布拉德·皮特和达姆森·伊德里斯主演的大片，全球票房超过6.34亿美元，并且是在真实的F1大奖赛周末期间拍摄的。
detailEn: F1 closing in on 1 billion fans as Stefano Domenicali hails female audience growth
Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali says the championship is nearing one billion global fans
Stefano Domenicali, CEO of the Formula One Group
Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali says the championship is closing in on 1 billion global fans, driven by a younger audience, an increase in female viewership and more access to driver personalities.
Speaking during an appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, Domenicali discussed F1's ongoing expansion and its success in growing in the United States.
"We are almost at 1 billion [fans]. We hopefully come back here, Jimmy, to celebrate that target, that number. But it is huge," Domenicali explained.

"F1, all around the world, is a world sport. We are going to 24 places around the world. Actually, tonight after this incredible opportunity, I go to Baku in Azerbaijan, then to Malaysia, then Singapore.

He attributed some of the growth to showing more of the 22 drivers' personalities via Netflix's Drive to Survive series and the drivers' own social media platforms, helping in turn to build their personal profiles.

"Of course, they are professional drivers, but they know they are part of a bigger ecosystem," he continued. "Because normally you see them with the gloves, with the helmet, with the overalls, so you don't recognise them. Now we have opened it up for them to be known."

Domenicali also pointed to the ongoing success of the three grands prix in the US in Miami, Austin and Las Vegas, explaining that the logistical challenges of the Las Vegas Strip circuit have paid off with sell-out crowds. He also noted the success of the F1 movie. The blockbuster, which starred Brad Pitt and Damson Idris, grossed over $634million at the global box office and was filmed during real-life F1 race weekends.
keyPointsZh: 多梅尼卡利在美国脱口秀节目《吉米·法伦今夜秀》上谈到了F1的持续扩张
F1在美国市场的增长取得成功
女性观众收视率上升是粉丝增长的重要推动力
keyPointsEn: Domenicali made the comments during an appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
F1 has achieved success in growing in the United States

items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队披露，前红牛车手丹尼尔·科维亚特今年以模拟器车手身份低调回归，成为车队本赛季F1复兴的意外助力。

media.altZh: 阿尔派2026赛季复兴获科维亚特助力

items.originalTitle: Alpine's surprise assist with its 2026 F1 revival
items.summaryEn: Alpine has revealed that former Red Bull driver Daniil Kvyat quietly rejoined the team this year as a simulator driver, serving as a surprise asset in its Formula 1 revival this season.
detailZh: 阿尔派车队披露了本赛季支持其F1复兴的一个意外资产——前红牛车手、领奖台获得者丹尼尔·科维亚特。
科维亚特在2014年至2020年间共参加了110场大奖赛，今年低调重返恩斯通车队，担任模拟器车手。
他曾在2021年短暂效力阿尔派担任储备车手，其F1生涯中多次为红牛旗下车队效力，中间在2018年休赛一年，当时他担任法拉利的模拟器车手。
科维亚特的角色一直未公开，他与阿尔派储备车手保罗·阿隆和库什·马伊尼分担模拟器工作。
这包括研发工作，也包括当阿隆需要前往海外分站现场时的比赛周末支持任务。
比赛周末期间，科维亚特与阿尔派正赛车手皮埃尔·加斯利保持联系，分享直接反馈；两人曾在红牛青年队做过队友，关系良好。
据信科维亚特在阿尔派日本站和加拿大站的周末逆转中发挥了重要作用。
阿尔派本赛季在F1中表现大幅提升，新规则以及改用梅赛德斯引擎使其重返中游车队前列。
离开F1后，科维亚特曾参加和/或测试NASCAR、顶级跑车和电动方程式赛车，并曾在阿布扎比担任与自动驾驶车辆竞速的参考车手。
他今年参加日本Super GT系列赛GT300组别，与老将高木虎之介搭档。两人目前在积分榜上排名第16，组别最佳成绩为第六名。
detailEn: Alpine has revealed a surprise asset supporting its Formula 1 revival this season - ex-Red Bull driver and podium finisher Daniil Kvyat.
Kvyat, who started 110 grands prix from 2014 to 2020, quietly rejoined the Enstone team this year as a simulator driver.

He had a stint at Alpine in 2021 as its reserve driver, having spent his F1 career racing for Red Bull's teams across multiple stints split by a year on the sidelines in 2018, when he was a simulator driver for Ferrari.
Kvyat's role has been kept under wraps as he shares simulator duties with Alpine reserve drivers Paul Aron and Kush Maini.
This includes development work but also race weekend support duties when Aron is required to be on-site at flyaway races.
During race weekends, Kvyat keeps in contact with Alpine race driver Pierre Gasly, who he was team-mate to at Red Bull's junior team and has a good relationship with, to share direct feedback.
Kvyat is understood to have played a significant role in Alpine's in-weekend turnarounds in Japan and Canada.
Alpine is enjoying a much improved season in F1 as the new rules and its switch to Mercedes engines have launched it back to the head of the midfield.
Kvyat has raced and/or tested NASCAR, top-level sportscar and Formula E machinery since his F1 exit, and had a role as a reference driver racing against an autonomous vehicle in Abu Dhabi.
He is competing in Japan's Super GT series this year in the GT300 category, alongside veteran driver Takashi Kogure. The pair are 16th in the points with a best class finish of sixth.

他与阿尔派储备车手保罗·阿隆和库什·马伊尼分担模拟器工作，包括研发及比赛周末支持。
比赛周末他与阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利保持联系并分享直接反馈，据信在日本和加拿大站的周末逆转中发挥了重要作用。

He shares simulator duties with Alpine reserve drivers Paul Aron and Kush Maini, covering development work and race weekend support.

During race weekends he keeps in contact with Alpine driver Pierre Gasly to share direct feedback, and is understood to have played a significant role in Alpine's in-weekend turnarounds in Japan and Canada.
